stage: A (zero promotion authority -- a pass earns a forward clock, never capital)

alignment.bar_label: resample() labels a bar with the START of its window
alignment.bar_fields: every book field is the MEAN over the window, not a close
alignment.signal: signal[i] = feature averaged over W_{i-1}; observable at T_i
alignment.entry_price: mid[i] = TWAP over W_i, begun at T_i -- the instant signal[i] completes. No price in the target window precedes the signal.
alignment.gap_rule: rows whose bar and its predecessor are not adjacent on the bar_ms grid are dropped; masking attenuates IC and cannot leak

excluded_before_seeing_numbers.liquidity_withdrawal: risk filter (0/1 flat-or-trade), not a directional signal -- an IC on it has no interpretation; probed on P&L instead

preregistration.symbol_policy: every recorded symbol on the venue; symbols are replications used to build a standard error, NOT separate hypotheses

leak_probe.what: bar_returns() enters at mid[i], the MEAN mid of the window the signal is measured over. The lagged arm enters one bar later, the first window that starts after the signal completes.

harness_power_note: stage_a_screen computes n_eff = n / (horizon_days * panel_width). That models OVERLAPPING daily-sampled returns; at sub-daily bars horizon_days < 1 so it MULTIPLIES n (1440x at 60s, 288x at 300s) and `powered` comes back true for free. These bars are non-overlapping, so n_eff is n. Every cell carries powered_honest/min_detectable_ic_honest computed from n directly.
headline: 36 of 450 cells SCREEN-INTERESTING; 105/360 leak probes collapse under a one-bar lag
